methodology.p95Method: nearest rank; n=6 per query, descriptive only
methodology.queryHashes: TotalMatches plus all fields of first nine SearchHit items; not all matching rows
methodology.latency: offscreen real-resource MainWindow.Show through matching result version and one ContextIdle frame; no physical hotkey/IME or final Shell icon completion
limitations: Sequential isolated processes; real machine not exclusive, standard QBox processes were active during part of the study.
Frozen volume/delta data; Shell application/shortcut metadata read from the current machine.
No real memory pressure or hard-vs-soft page fault breakdown; no sustained USN, merge or index-build throughput test.
Memory counters sampled sequentially, not atomically; GC committed/heap fields describe the last GC. Absolute numbers include diagnostic overhead.
Single 65-second idle cycle per candidate and two baseline cycles; not a production tail-latency guarantee.

unreadable metadata recovery and action argument change without rediscovery

cases.note: Excluded warm timings: separate validation build overlapped warm-after-idle samples; first-after-idle completed before that build.
